name: Circulation
definition: The routes through a space and the clear widths that they keep free of furniture.

measures.measure: clear width of a main path for a following camera
measures.reference: ≥ 3, or ≥ 2 tiles in a tile game

sources.title: Julius Panero and Martin Zelnik, Human Dimension and Interior Space (Whitney Library of Design, 1979)
Ernst and Peter Neufert, Architects' Data (Wiley-Blackwell, 4th English edition, 2012)
